best_idea: A level-gated encounter table: take the highest tier at or below the player's level, pick one entry uniformly (or every entry at or below the level for an all-levels list), roll a none-chance first, recurse into nested tables at the same level, and draw the spawn count as one plus a die roll.
decision_why: Keep the levelled table (none-chance, top tier, all-levels flag, nested tables) and the count rule as zone data feeding groups capped at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; reject the rest-interrupt and monthly cell respawn, which depend on sleep rules and game-time months Frankendom does not model.
acceptance: Server test with a zone list of entries at levels 1, 3 and 5 and a none-chance of 20: for a level-4 player, 10,000 seeded picks give a none rate of 20 percent plus or minus 1 point, only level-3 entries appear unless the all-levels flag is set, and group counts stay between 1 and 3.
